[R225] POSITIVE - exact head 9d6109ccf924c03308cb8aa202ce68a435cd4f8d

R225-2, cold independent internal Codex review of kebag-logic/milan-fpga PR #507 / issue #440. Tree: `1d322d866da6b8d19ccd46cfd7ef5f405e9dadb4`. Prior reviewed head: `0d43ff25d38917e77bb5c3d2ddb6473013cea3ba`. Base: `b17580b91deb11f3441dfc5d7f9fafe539d929b8`.

R226-F1 is RESOLVED under its original reviewer-assigned Tests and Docs lenses. No BLOCKER, MAJOR or MINOR remains in this review. The previous R226 overall POSITIVE did not clear these lenses; this verdict follows examination of the corrected commit and new independent execution. Optional suggestions remain optional and were not added to the correction's scope. This is a review verdict, not a completed merge bar.

The public contract was reconstructed from AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/README.md, REQUIREMENTS.md section 8, code-quality rule 12, DOC_GENERATION.md, CI_WORKFLOWS.md, issue #440 and its decisions, the linked historical public reports, both original PR reviews, the correction diff/history, and public author/manager evidence. No private author or reviewer reasoning was received or read. The final read-only observation at 2026-09-22 09:50:10 UTC confirms the remote PR and branch still identify this exact head, the PR is ready, and live dev remains the stated base. There was no publication scheduling mismatch.

[R225] PASS Tests - `scripts/gen_toc_closer_cases.py:25`, `:56`, `:91`, `:112`; `scripts/gen_toc.py:55`, `:834`; `scripts/check_em_dash.py:945`, `:968`; `retention.json`, `mutations.json`, `consumer.json` - R226-F1's closer-only widening is detected through both actual parser classification and actual copied-label judgment.

Requirement/evidence for resolving R226-F1: [the original MINOR](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/pull/507#issuecomment-5772986192) and [accepted correction](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/pull/507#issuecomment-5772995412) require discrimination against other ASCII closer names. The 24 new raw cases cover four openers, three invalid closer names, and both opening-line/later-line placement. Six new real-Git label cases cover all three names at both placements. Their expected HTML classification and findings/exemptions are independent of the shared RAW_HTML_TAGS tuple.

Each independently constructed mutant widens only `_type_1_end` to one extra name, leaving RAW_HTML_TAGS and the opener patterns unchanged. These are semantically identical to R15/R16/X04; the local patches use tuple unpacking where the public patches use tuple addition. Full patches and logs are retained.

| Closer-only mutation | Prior TOC / em-dash selftest exits | Corrected exits | Corrected behavioral failures |
|---|---|---|---|
| add div (R15 property) | 0 / 0 | 1 / 2 | eight `I440-T-other-name` cases; two `I440-E-other-div` cases |
| add title (R16 property) | 0 / 0 | 1 / 2 | eight raw cases; two corresponding label cases |
| add xmp (X04 property) | 0 / 0 | 1 / 2 | eight raw cases; two corresponding label cases |

These failures are behavioral, with no GUARD diagnostic. Each bad label row produces two diagnostics, so the unchanged em-dash failure summary says four diagnostics out of 57 arms; this is two failing label cases, not four independent cases.

The independent consumer probe uses eight real-Git pages per engine: all three invalid names at both positions, plus two legitimate cross-name controls. Actual `gen_toc --write` creates head navigation, and `--check` accepts it. Direct `judge_page` calls show that each mutant changes its two hidden base headings from raw HTML to prose and its two copied labels from findings/exemptions 1/0 to 0/1. Both unmutated snapshots reject all six invalid labels and exempt both valid labels. Old mutated CLIs reach judgment and incorrectly exempt their matching labels; their overall exit 1 comes from other negative pages and does not detect those escapes. Corrected mutated `check_em_dash --base` exits 2 at the permanent controls before page judgment. No CLI selftest was bypassed. `gen_toc --check` itself has no automatic selftest; the fail-before-judgment claim applies to the em-dash CLI.

All 683 prior TOC cases are retained by family, identity, fixture bytes and predicate bytecode. Four unchanged tally-guard predicates derive their synthetic totals from the raised floor, so their closures change from 5464 to 5656. All 17 prior I440 label rows are identical, and check_em_dash.py is byte-identical, retaining its other 34 arms. Corrected unmutated selftests pass 707/707 and 57/57. Receipts: `populations/`, `retention.json`, `guard-floor-closures.json`, `unchanged-production.json`, and `mutations/head-correct.*.log`.

[R225] PASS Docs - `docs/DOC_GENERATION.md:55`, `:57`; `correction.diff`; public correction comment 5773298390 and native completion comment 5774050784 - the revised coverage claim accurately names fence trailers, literal type-1 boundaries, and raw/shipped controls for div, title and xmp. The failure mode described by R226-F1 is now held by permanent tests. Its required outcome and verification are satisfied by the mutation and consumer receipts above. The public artifacts distinguish old-head evidence, corrected native completion, and the queued replica. They provide reproducible sources and commands. No production policy or issue #437 scope was rewritten.

[R225] PASS Conformance - `scripts/gen_toc.py:473`, `:484`, `:503`; `scripts/gen_toc_closer_cases.py:44`, `:56`, `:91`; `renderer/results.json`, `renderer-consumer/results.json`, `correction.diff` - the revised negative expectations implement [decision 5771170243](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/440#issuecomment-5771170243): the four literal type-1 names alone terminate these blocks, including on the opening line. This agrees with [CommonMark 4.6](https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/#html-blocks); the existing fence suffix rule agrees with [4.5](https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/#fenced-code-blocks).

Fresh GitHub gfm rendering of all 24 added raw fixtures yields zero h2 headings; two valid cross-name controls each yield one. Eight additional requests render the exact independent consumer base pages: all six invalid-closer pages have zero h2 headings, and both valid pages have four. Requests, responses, timestamps and hashes are retained. These are 34 fresh synthetic renderer observations, not a rerun of the historical 205-row campaign.

The original four issue acceptance criteria remain supported by the public R225-1/R226-1 measurements and mutation evidence, plus this correction review. Their original base/head sweeps and tracked-page comparisons retain their original attribution and heads. The complete correction diff has three files. gen_toc.py is byte-identical to the prior head except `MIN_ARMS = 683` becoming `707`; check_em_dash.py, gen_toc_cases.py and gen_toc_guards.py are byte-identical. No parser, refusal, normalization, container or provenance behavior changed. Historical measurements are not presented as newly executed results on 9d6109.

[R225] PASS Robustness - `scripts/gen_toc.py:484`, `:503`; `scripts/gen_toc_closer_cases.py:34`, `:112`; `boundaries.json`, `consumer.json`, `mutations.json` - reapplied at the corrected head because the selftest-bearing parser file and fixture artifact changed. All 328 independent boundary rows pass: other-name rejection at both positions and EOF, ASCII capitals, valid cross-name termination, malformed suffixes, recovery through a later legitimate closer, a subsequent new block, both fence markers and shorter/equal/longer runs, valid/invalid trailers, and comment/type-6 precedence. Permanent prior refusal and CR controls remain present and pass. Mutated shipped gates fail closed at preflight. This round does not claim to rerun the original 3,614-row boundary campaign.

[R225] PASS RTL - retained R225-1 coverage at `0d43ff25d38917e77bb5c3d2ddb6473013cea3ba`, supported by that round's `candidate.diff`/scope result and this round's `candidate.diff`, `correction.diff`, `changed-paths.txt` - the complete PR still changes only documentation tooling and DOC_GENERATION.md. No HDL, hardware interface, clock/reset/CDC logic, constraint, build source list, workflow, version or gitlink changed. The software ownership boundary also remains unchanged: gen_toc owns parsing; the fixture module supplies test inputs and expectations. The prior clean R226-1 RTL result independently agrees. This is retained unchanged-artifact coverage, not a fresh current-head hardware review.

Reviewer-owned coverage ledger:

| Lens | Covering round | Exact covered head | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Conformance | R225-2 | 9d6109ccf924c03308cb8aa202ce68a435cd4f8d | CLEAN; fresh review, historical measurements explicitly attributed |
| RTL | R225-1 | 0d43ff25d38917e77bb5c3d2ddb6473013cea3ba | CLEAN; retained coverage, scope unchanged through corrected head |
| Robustness | R225-2 | 9d6109ccf924c03308cb8aa202ce68a435cd4f8d | CLEAN; freshly applied |
| Tests | R225-2 | 9d6109ccf924c03308cb8aa202ce68a435cd4f8d | CLEAN; R226-F1 resolved |
| Docs | R225-2 | 9d6109ccf924c03308cb8aa202ce68a435cd4f8d | CLEAN; R226-F1 resolved |

Focused reviewer gates all exit 0: TOC selftest 707/707; TOC check 105 lists; anchors 144; sites 25; em-dash selftest 57/57 and actual-base gate zero findings over 34 added lines; docs_check zero findings across 163 Markdown and 827 scrubbed text files; documentation style, paths, and diff whitespace. Exact commands and outputs are in `gates.json` and `gates/`.

Manager-attributed native evidence: [completion comment 5774050784](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/pull/507#issuecomment-5774050784) and archive `87c0683b8df06587772afa344e78d4ce56fccabb`. The downloaded completion/results records identify 9d6109 and report all 43 static/builder commands and five native commands completed successfully. Inspected native logs corroborate 55 parent suites / 2,118,264 checks, Yosys portability/structural gates, protocol-processor 14,903 checks, gPTP make all, and BDD 14 features / 316 scenarios / 1515 steps, with zero failures. Four declared field-campaign skips contribute zero checks. Physical calibration gate 11 remains NOT RUN under the recorded deferral. This reviewer did not rerun these broad gates. The factual author archive at `4c39e5fb2408b62a06f55a4230d81db5ea76855c` was read separately from reviewer execution; evidence branches were never merged.

Pending merge obligations: at the final observation, public comment 5774292729 still says the all-four trusted ready replica is queued behind PR505. No public notice confirms actual runner execution. No hosted check/run/status endpoint was inspected or polled, and no replica or hosted success is claimed. The manager must obtain the completed corrected-head replica and the seven required hosted contexts, including rtl-fast and both exhaustive aggregates, obtain the independent external corrected-head verdict, finish all review rounds, and recheck the current merge candidate before exercising standing maintainer authorization. Live dev was still the stated ancestor, so the head tree equals the current candidate tree; the manager's native candidate evidence applies to that recorded state. Any later dev movement requires the prescribed candidate validation. Post-merge containment, issue closure and Done remain future work.

Integrity and limits: the source clone remains detached at the exact head/tree. Initial and final integrity records are identical. All 851 tracked non-gitlink files match their index blobs and modes; the index tree equals HEAD, the index SHA-256 is unchanged, and all status/diff/staged outputs are empty. Four gitlinks and their empty, uninitialized directories are unchanged. No source edits, product commits, pushes, public comments/reviews, metadata changes, merge, other agents, author/reviewer contact, Docker/act, hardware, installation or privileged action occurred. Only synthetic real-Git test repositories received fixture commits. Probe concurrency never exceeded four jobs. No independent full native or submodule-dependent ratchet pass is claimed.

REPORT.md and the factual instruments/receipts are under `$WORKSPACE_HOME/milan-fpga-management/2026-09-22/507-r2-r225`. `RECEIPTS.md` explains reproduction; `MANIFEST.sha256` binds the deliverables. The manager publishes this report; the reviewer has not self-published.

R225-2 FINISHED

[R226] POSITIVE - exact head 9d6109ccf924c03308cb8aa202ce68a435cd4f8d

Round R226-2 is the external cold re-review (Opus) of kebag-logic/milan-fpga PR #507 for issue #440, after the correction for R226-F1.

- Head: `9d6109ccf924c03308cb8aa202ce68a435cd4f8d`, tree `1d322d866da6b8d19ccd46cfd7ef5f405e9dadb4`. The PR head, `refs/heads/440-markdown-closers` and `refs/pull/507/head` all equal it. This was checked at 11:38 and again at 11:58 +02:00. The PR was open and ready (receipt 04).
- Prior reviewed head: `0d43ff25d38917e77bb5c3d2ddb6473013cea3ba` (tree `c0e67508d3b753c21a28a243d365c4c37ed86d43`). It is the head's only parent.
- Base: `b17580b91deb11f3441dfc5d7f9fafe539d929b8`. It is also the live `dev` tip, and an ancestor of the head.
- Lenses applied at this head: Conformance, RTL, Robustness, Tests, Docs. All five were applied afresh at `9d6109cc`. The ledger below banks no prior coverage.

**Verdict basis.**

- R226-F1 (MINOR; Tests, Docs) is resolved at this head (next section).
- No BLOCKER, MAJOR or MINOR is open under any lens.
- This round adds two optional SUGGESTIONs, S1 and S2. The five R226-1 SUGGESTIONs are unchanged and remain optional.
- The production walk and gate are byte-identical to `0d43ff25`, except the self-test floor `MIN_ARMS`.

This is a code-review verdict only. Pending execution gates are listed separately below.

**Authority read:**

- AGENTS.md, and CONTRIBUTING.md sections 2, 3 and 6.1.
- Issue #440: the body, scope comment 5651705425, decision 5771170243, assignment 5771559992, and the A158 and A164 comments.
- PR #507: the body and 13 of the 14 comments present when this round started. These include R226-1 (5772986192), the F1 acceptance (5772995412), the correction notices (5773270202, 5773298390), the native evidence (5774050784) and the re-review start (5774292729). The body of R225-1's review (5772722112) was not read. Of the two comments posted later (5774554247 and 5774554525), only the first lines were read.
- CommonMark 0.31.2 sections 4.5 and 4.6 (R226-1 receipt 11).
- The diff and commit history.
- The public evidence commits `26f9c867` (R226-1), `4c39e5fb` (A164 author) and `87c0683b` (manager native).

## R226-F1 result: resolved under Tests and Docs

R226-F1 asked for three things:

- a control that fails when the closer site accepts a closing tag of another ASCII name (a raw-walk arm at minimum; a shipped-label row preferred);
- R15 (div), R16 (title) and X04 (xmp) to each fail at least one arm;
- DOC_GENERATION.md:55 to be true as written, or narrowed to what the controls hold.

| F1 item | Evidence at `9d6109cc` | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Raw-walk control (minimum) | 24 `I440-T-other-name` arms, `scripts/gen_toc_closer_cases.py:25, :56-58`. They cover 4 openers, a later-line and an opening-line closer, and div, title and xmp. Each is graded on the real `blocks()` classification of the probe line. | met |
| Shipped-label control (preferred) | 6 `I440-E-other-*` rows, `:91-96`. They cover `<pre>`, both positions and the three names. Each runs the real `check_em_dash.judge_page` on real base and head commits. Each requires 1 finding, 0 exemptions and the "mirrors no heading" note. | met |
| R15, R16, X04 each fail at least one arm | Each fails exactly its 8 raw arms (`gen_toc.py --selftest` exit 1, 699/707) and its 2 label rows (`check_em_dash.py --selftest` exit 2). No other arm fails (mutants-head/). | met |
| E2E: no E14/E15 exemption unless a self-test already failed | Under R15, R16 and X04 the real `check_em_dash.py --base` exits 2 on its own controls before judging any page (e2e/e2e-vs-oracle.txt). | met |
| DOC_GENERATION.md:55 true or narrowed | `:55` now reads "`I440` controls cover fence trailers and literal type-1 closer boundaries." `:57` reads "Raw-walk and shipped-label controls reject `div`, `title`, and `xmp`." Both are true at this head. | met |

These controls test closer-site widening, not a widened `RAW_HTML_TAGS`:

- In the R15, R16 and X04 runs, `RAW_HTML_TAGS` is still the four names. The existing arm "the type-1 names are the renderer's four" passes, and only the new controls fail.
- Widening at one call site catches only that site's controls:
  - `_still_open` alone fails the 4 later-line raw arms and the later-line label row;
  - `_opens` alone fails the 4 opening-line raw arms and the inline label row;
  - both also trip the existing site-count guard.
- A literal alternation that no longer reads `RAW_HTML_TAGS` fails the same 8 raw arms and 2 label rows.
- At `0d43ff25`, R15, R16, X04 and the three literal-alternation mutants pass both self-tests. There, the shipped CLI exempts the hidden labels: E14 and E20 (div), E15 and E21 (title), E19 and E22 (xmp). So the new controls are what detect the defect.
- The actual effect on each consumer:
  - Under R15, `gen_toc.py --check`, which runs no self-test, reports NO TOC for the E14 and E20 base pages. That is, the generator would list a hidden heading.
  - Under each mutant, the docs workflow's `gen_toc.py --selftest` step (`.github/workflows/docs.yml:380`) fails, and its `check_em_dash.py --base` step (`:87`) refuses.
- GitHub's renderer confirms the new expectations. None of the 30 new fixture sources renders its probe or Old heading, in either gfm or markdown mode. Six positive controls from the same session do render theirs (render/).

## Findings

```text
[R226] SUGGESTION Tests, Docs - scripts/gen_toc_closer_cases.py:20, :25 - the other-name controls sample three names; widening to any other name still passes
Requirement/evidence: R226-F1's stated minimum (one raw-walk arm) and its verification
  (R15, R16, X04) are met, and DOC_GENERATION.md:57 names exactly the three sampled names.
  Adding any other name at the closer site still passes 707/707 and 57. Measured: iframe,
  noscript, plaintext, noembed, noframes, listing, p, span, code, b, and the synthetic name
  pre2 (mutants Z-*, mutants-head/summary.tsv).
  R226-1 rows R226-T-othername-{pre,script}-{iframe,noscript,plaintext,noembed,noframes,
  listing,p,span,code} render 0 headings, so each of those widenings would reopen the escape.
  The comment at :20 says the fixtures "hold both name-set boundaries".
Impact: optional. The residual needs an edit at the closer site that names an unsampled tag.
Required outcome: optional. Either a population-wide or structural control of the closer's
  name set, or wording at :20 that says the widening side is sampled.
Verification: the Z-* mutants fail at least one arm, or the comment at :20 matches
  _OTHER_NAMES.
```

```text
[R226] SUGGESTION Robustness, Tests - scripts/check_em_dash.py:947-949; scripts/gen_toc_closer_cases.py:136-139 - a git refusal inside the label rows exits 1 with a traceback, not 2
Requirement/evidence: check_em_dash.py:954 documents "0 clean, 1 findings, 2 cannot judge
  or an arm did not bite". selftest() wraps the planted controls (:935-938) so that a Refusal
  is rc 2. The em_dash_arms call at :948-949 sits outside that wrapper, as the base's
  _base_derivation_arms call at :947 already does.
  In a disposable copy, a Refusal injected into the label rows makes the real CLI print a
  traceback and exit 1 (receipt 11b). The same injection into a planted control returns rc 2
  (receipt 11).
Impact: optional. Only a git failure during the self-test reaches this path. The run still
  fails, so a clean result is impossible; only the meaning of the exit code is wrong. The
  correction adds six rows to this harness and does not change the path.
Required outcome: optional. A Refusal inside these arms is reported as an arm that did not
  hold (rc 2), as it already is for the planted controls.
Verification: rerun the injection in receipt 11b; the CLI exits 2 and names the problem.
```

## Clean lenses

```text
[R226] PASS Conformance - scripts/gen_toc.py:473-500 at 9d6109cc; scripts/gen_toc_closer_cases.py:25, :56-58, :91-96; render/render-report.json; render/render-positive-report.json; sweep-r2/summary.json; e2e/e2e-vs-oracle.txt; R226-1 receipts/11-commonmark-clauses.txt - the closing rules still match decision 5771170243 and CommonMark 0.31.2 sections 4.5 and 4.6, and the new expectations agree with GitHub
  The closer sites are byte-identical to 0d43ff25 (receipt 03). The fence trailer strips only
  CLASSES["blank"]. `_type_1_end` searches `</(pre|script|style|textarea)>` under ASCII_FOLD,
  on both the opening line and later lines.
  CommonMark 4.6 end condition 1 names only those four end tags, so div, title and xmp end no
  type-1 block.
  All 30 new fixture sources render without their heading in gfm and markdown modes, and the
  six positive controls render theirs.
  The real reader at this head, over the 283 R226-1 fixtures: 283/283 agree. The shipped
  answer is 211 agree and 72 globally refused, with 0 escapes and 0 withholds. At the base:
  15 escapes and 41 withholds.
  Every base-to-head change falls in a fence-trailer or type-1-closer row.
  22 real Git pages through both shipped CLIs: each label is exempt exactly when GitHub
  renders the base heading (E01-E22).
  Issue acceptance criteria 1-4 hold. Every R226-1 mutant caught at 0d43ff25 is still
  caught; R00, the revert, fails 157 I440 arms and 10 I440-E diagnostics.
```
